notes: Twenty-four source and thirty-nine target IDs each partitioned once.

The second *of* (t033) is read as the distributed repetition of the verb's own object preposition over the elliptical comparison (*make mention of thy love ... [of] wine*), rules 44 and 25; giving *than of* jointly to the comparative מִן is the named alternative.
s020 מִן → *more than* heads on *than* under rule 24 as the word carrying the preposition's own relation, with *more* named as the competing head.
s010 חֲדָרָיו → *into ... chambers* is rule 33's adverbial accusative of direction, the supplied *into* licensed by the noun's own case-function.
